title: The Ultimate Bronze-Bait Sequence
review:
The Blind Flip (0:00 - 0:04): Wukong hops into the pit completely blind. Look at the minimap: top line is pushed, mid has no prio, and there isn't a single blue ward inside or behind the dragon pit. He just blindly jumped in hoping the enemy team was taking a collective nap.

Handing over Drake on a Silver Platter (0:06 - 0:19): Because Wukong started the objective with zero pressure, Sylas and the Red Team walked up, saw a free target trapped in a pit, and simply took over the dragon. Wukong basically acted as Red Team's unpaid leash.

The "I Have No Vision" Penalty (0:27 - 0:33): Predictably, Red Team smites the Cloud Drake, and because Wukong dragged his team into a dead-end jungle corridor without any vision on enemy flanks, Katarina and Sylas instantly collapse on the choke point. Xerath gets instantly erased, and Wukong achieves the rare feat of losing an objective, baiting his midlaner, and giving up a double kill all in one brainless play.
